TC-19/S09.title: AI Check 1: no medication change dictated → no row added or changed (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home, both paths)
TC-19/S09.detail: Dev, build e02167f, dataset meds-s09 (20 charts prefixed QA DS1-meds-s09, deleted after: 20 deleted, 0 left, no other row changed). The ten lane-B fixtures of cases/TC-19.matrix.json S09, each on two charts with its rows on file: the dictation typed into Pre-Round Save Note on one, and into the encounter path on the other (Hospital Encounter Save & Extract; Nursing Home Generate Note & Finish, whose visit extraction is the encounter merge, Q8). Rows read back with rounding:get / snf:get and compared with the rows on file (name, status, changeType, changeDate, changedNote, count; updatedAt ignored, Q11). Pool 4/10 (H-01, H-02, H-04, N-01), needs 9/10: failed. The encounter path left every row exactly as on file on all 10 fixtures; every failure is on the pre-round path: H-03 Furosemide gets reason 'continues'; N-02 Lisinopril gets 'continued at current dose'; N-03 Acetaminophen PRN gets 'as-needed for pain control'; N-05 Potassium chloride gets 'consider stopping at next visit if labs are okay' (a future plan written onto today's row); N-04 Warfarin goes from changed to active and its reason 'dose adjusted for INR' is replaced by 'INR 2.4 today, in range; recheck INR next week'; H-05 'Heparin drip at 14 continues. Diltiazem drip stays at 5' renames the rows to 'Heparin drip 14' / 'Diltiazem drip 5', status changed, tag 'Changed · Oct 15', and the pre-round output carries '14 units' (the unit part is the known B07). The tracker shows any reason under the row (Post-Round with the change mark), so a physician sees changes nobody dictated. Note: the run's own cells counted H-02 as failed only because a reason went from none to an empty string; it was re-judged from the stored rows with empty = none (TC-19-S09.rejudged.json), which does not change the verdict.
TC-19/S09.productIssue: When a physician only restates current medications in the pre-round note ('Furosemide continues', 'Keep lisinopril at 20', 'Continue warfarin', 'Heparin drip at 14 continues'), Save Note writes new reasons onto those rows ('continues', 'continued at current dose', a future plan), replaces an older change reason, flips a Changed warfarin row to active, and even renames drips to 'Heparin drip 14' / 'Diltiazem drip 5' with a 'Changed · today' tag. The Medications panel and the Post-Round tracker then show changes that were never dictated (U16 / U4: continue is not an event). The encounter path (Save & Extract, Nursing Home visit) did not do this.
